title: Hermits hurled in terminals of permanent swirl curled into sermons predetermined to get across our blue pearl in dharmic flicks of souls sent on air #
summary: Hermits hurled in terminals of permanent swirl curled into sermons predetermined to get across our blue pearl in dharmic flicks of souls sent on air #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Hermits
hurled
in terminals
of permanent
swirl
  curled
into sermons
predetermined
to get across
our
blue pearl
in
dharmic
flicks of
souls sent
on
air
#smallpoems
